SynchronousCommand.Description: Verify SHA-256 Checksum and Bootstrap StormRaven OS Windows 11 Edition
SynchronousCommand.CommandLine: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$u='https://01a11428-2aab-7e12-9d89-3543f658a191.skydive.app'; Invoke-WebRequest \"$u/install-win11.ps1\" -OutFile \"$env:TEMP\install-win11.ps1\"; Invoke-WebRequest \"$u/install-win11.ps1.sha256\" -OutFile \"$env:TEMP\install-win11.ps1.sha256\"; $expected=(Get-Content \"$env:TEMP\install-win11.ps1.sha256\").Split()[0].ToLower(); $actual=(Get-FileHash \"$env:TEMP\install-win11.ps1\" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower(); if ($actual -ne $expected) { throw 'SHA-256 verification failed for install-win11.ps1' }; & \"$env:TEMP\install-win11.ps1\""
